cards.title: A picture as shared reference
cards.caption: Local sample illustration. Your photos, scans and screenshots can take this place.

cards.title: Keep the explanation beside it
cards.html:
Pictures can carry the discussion

Keep a photo, a diagram, a scanned page or a screenshot visible while the session explains what matters.

You can ask: What am I looking at? Which detail matters? Can you compare another version?

Updates keep the same card identity and preserve your arrangement.

cards.title: Ask about what you see
cards.prompt: What would you like the session to explain about this picture?
